Needs edits. (1) Betting language: 'odds' in story text line 8, AFC ladder header 'PLAYOFF ODDS', hero label, site card tag -> 'playoff chances'; '7-point favorite' in step 2 is spread language -> 'a team our model expects to win by 7'. (2) Clinch framing: 'most likely clinch week 14' (28%) while 59% of sims clinch later and the median is week 15; headline, hero, dek and clinch graphic (41% highlighted next to 'Most likely clinch') mislead. (3) QB table '-1 pts' reads as scoreboard points -> 'down 1 point of chance' / percentage points; Seahawks +1 contradicts 'penalty is zero'. (4) Jets row: 'lost for a week or more'/'Starting now: Klubnik' conflicts with 'should be fine'. (5) 'biggest game left in the division race' unsupported unless computed. (6) Lead buries the Maye injury, Patriots -7 pts. (7) Chart titles not takeaways; ladder 'PLAYOFF LINE' reads as betting line; '12%' clipped by fill in clinch graphic. (8) Method never ties back to the Bills' 96%. Check 'blend at least as well in 5 of 7' vs stat-heads table (looks like 6 of 7).

Re-run with seed 2026 reproduces the CSV exactly. Records, lead, NE paragraph, QB effect, absences, drift and backtest numbers all check out. Fixes needed: (1) The headline 'will most likely clinch it in week 14' overclaims: week 14 is only the most common single week (28%), only 41% have clinched by then, and the median is week 15. (2) The backtest is in-sample for 2019-2023 (points-model fit, residual pairs and K tuning) and drift uses later seasons, which isn't disclosed. In the only out-of-sample seasons (2024-25) the 50/50 baseline beat the blend (Brier 0.118 vs 0.128). (3) The Jets plan doesn't match the reporting: draw with missed 0 forces at least 1 missed game (median 2) and lists Klubnik as the starter, but tests found nothing major and Smith starts if healthy; NYJ is also shaded in both charts. (4) '7-point favorite' is betting language. (5) '3,266 games' should be team-games. (6) Minor: Seattle's +1 shows with a zero penalty, it/they grammar, the NYG/BAL penalty is for a backup-to-backup switch, the NE minimum-4 pool has only 10 absences, and the test chart footer cites QB reports.
